findings.location: Paragraph about 1631 (source.html paragraph starting "Samuel no estuvo ajeno...")
findings.source_quote: In 1631, only four short years after he began his work as a pastor, his wife passed away. His two children also became ill and left this world.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the Spanish tense to a simple past to match the source and sound natural: replace "Sus dos hijos también enfermaban y dejaron este mundo." with "Sus dos hijos también enfermaron y dejaron este mundo."
findings.translation_quote: Sus dos hijos también enfermaban y dejaron este mundo.

findings.location: Paragraph about government change (source.html paragraph starting "The government eventually changed hands...")
findings.source_quote: The government eventually changed hands, which gave more liberty to the non-conformist Covenanters.
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid mixing English and Spanish and render the movement name idiomatically. Replace "los disidentes covenanters" with "los covenanters no conformistas" or simply "los covenanters" (with appropriate lowercase/uppercase consistent with house style). Also capitalize 'Commonwealth' if treated as a proper noun: replace "el gobierno del commonwealth" with "el gobierno del Commonwealth" or translate as "la Mancomunidad (Commonwealth)" if preferred.
findings.translation_quote: El gobierno eventualmente cambió de manos, lo que dio más libertad a los disidentes covenanters.
